evals.prompt: Build the smallest Skein counter example I can paste into one HTML file.
evals.expected: Uses <template skein>, skein.js, ordinary this.count state, an @event binding, and no npm/build tooling.

evals.prompt: Build a Skein marketing page where SEO matters and add an interactive calculator.
evals.expected: Keeps heading, value proposition, links and core copy as ordinary HTML; uses Skein only for the interactive calculator; does not falsely claim SSR.

evals.prompt: Render an editable project list that can be reordered without losing typed input values.
evals.expected: Uses each={projects} with stable key={id}; relies on keyed identity rather than rebuilding innerHTML; duplicate keys are treated as an error.

evals.prompt: Render a Skein list of primitive tag strings with their indexes.
evals.expected: Uses each={tags}, {$value} for the current primitive value, and index or $index for the list position.

evals.prompt: Create a label whose for attribute reactively follows an input id.
evals.expected: Uses native for={inputId}; does not confuse it with list rendering, which uses each={...}.

evals.prompt: Create a child Skein volume control that accepts volume from its parent and asks the parent to change it.
evals.expected: Declares input('volume', fallback), receives .volume={volume} as a DOM property, and dispatches a bubbling composed CustomEvent upward; does not create two-way binding or an event bus.

evals.prompt: Make an interactive generative SVG poster in Skein controlled by pointer position.
evals.expected: Keeps actual SVG markup, binds only dynamic attributes/CSS variables, uses native CSS/SVG features, and avoids a graphics framework.

evals.prompt: Drive several animated CSS variables on a Skein custom element without rebuilding its inline style, and clear one optional value when it is absent.
evals.expected: Uses separate --name={path} bindings, keeps ordinary static style declarations independent, relies on CSS custom-property inheritance through Shadow DOM, and uses null/undefined/false to remove only the optional declaration; does not assemble a reactive style string.

evals.prompt: Create a Canvas animation component in Skein that stops cleanly when disposed.
evals.expected: Keeps Canvas imperative, uses Skein for reactive controls/state, and cancels animation/timers via onCleanup or abortSignal where applicable.

evals.prompt: Optimize Skein list rendering after Array.reverse().
evals.expected: Preserves keyed DOM identity, reads architecture guidance/tests first, does not introduce VDOM or dependencies, and adds a regression/performance correctness test.
